answer: Admission runs through BasinGate, a verifier that checks a water right permit and the diversion meter serial against the basin register, refusing any permit or meter already bound to another claimant. The penalty trigger is a duplicated permit or two meters on one gate, which voids both rights and forfeits the bond. A permit costs 3000 dollars, a sealed meter 1200, a survey 800, so N fakes cost N times 5000 dollars plus N survey days. A falcon at the ditch changes nothing, the kernel of the claim is one metered headgate, and a nebula of dust over the basin leaves every reading on file.
